concepts.title: Two Paws Were Too Slow, So He Used All Four 🐾🐱
concepts.en_line: The moles had no chance once he brought all four paws to the game.
concepts.ko_line: 두 발로 안 되면 네 발로 두더지 잡기 🐾

shots.image: Photorealistic Turkish Van cat with a semi-long soft chalk-white body coat, auburn-red patches on top of its head between the ears, a fluffy auburn-red tail with faint darker rings, a pink nose and bright amber eyes, crouching in focus on the front edge of a low tabletop whack-a-mole game with a plain glossy red-painted wooden cabinet and a flat board with nine round holes, three soft gray-brown plush mole toys with tiny pink noses poking up from three of the holes, one front paw lifted and ready, a cosy retro arcade behind with warm blurred neon glows and colourful round bulbs along the cabinet edge, the whole cat fully in frame and clearly visible, vertical composition
shots.motion: The Turkish Van cat crouches on the edge of the whack-a-mole board with its eyes locked on the nearest plush mole, wiggles its hips a little, then gently taps the plush mole on the head with one front paw, and the mole sinks a little into its hole. The other plush moles bob slightly up and down in their holes, and the round bulbs on the cabinet blink in a soft chasing pattern as the warm neon glows in the background. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

shots.edit: Keep exactly the same Turkish Van cat with the same fur pattern, face and eye color. Now the cat stands proudly in the middle of the same red whack-a-mole board with its legs spread wide, each of its four paws pressing down on a different soft gray-brown plush mole in four different holes, its chest puffed out, its auburn-red tail held high and its amber eyes half closed in a smug, victorious look. The same cosy retro arcade with warm blurred neon glows and colourful round bulbs along the cabinet edge, the whole cat fully in frame. Photorealistic, vertical composition.
shots.motion: The Turkish Van cat holds its proud four-paw pose on the whack-a-mole board and keeps each paw on its plush mole. It slowly tilts its head to one side, blinks slowly with a smug look, and gently sways its fluffy auburn-red tail to the beat. The round bulbs on the cabinet flash in a happy chasing pattern, and the warm neon lights behind it pulse softly. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

trend.why_now: Evergreen idea for a Saturday arcade outing. My searches found no current cat or arcade-game trend from the last 7-30 days that fit this format, so this uses the timeless 'cat outsmarts the game' joke.
trend.pattern: game setup and fail-to-win turn: shot 1 shows a focused hunter crouch and one slow paw tap, then shot 2 shows him using all four paws at once to win, with a smug victory pose for the payoff
